content:
jia: heads-up — noticed a cohort of viewer users briefly showed the 'Rotate key' button in the Console. Repro steps and logs below. :eyes:

alex: do we have scope? which cluster/region?

jia: US-west prod. rollout for role-mapping change (PR #4721) at 10:12 UTC. A/B cohort = 7% traffic. Steps:
1) login as user-role=viewer via SSO
2) open Project Settings -> Keys
3) rotate button visible and clickable (but returns 403 on click)

jia: logs:
```
2026-03-19T10:12:34Z auth: user=acct:123 role=viewer token=ey... feature=role-mapping-v2
2026-03-19T10:12:34Z ui: render=keys_page cohort=A button=rotate visible=true
2026-03-19T10:12:34Z api: POST /projects/123/keys/rotate status=403 user=acct:123
```

sam: hmm looks like UI gating used role attribute client-side only. Are we checking full permission set server-side on render? :warning:

maria: the role-mapping-v2 change updated precedence of legacy 'editor' alias. It was meant to only affect dedicated customers. PR 4721 changed mapping in auth-service only, not in UI flags. I'll pull the deploy.

sec-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-0319-27 — potential ACL exposure. Audit trails collected in /incidents/INC-2026-0319-27

oliver: KMS metadata issue — rotation calls are returning 403 but KMS logs don't show envelope key id for these users. We may be missing KMS-kms_key_id in our audit payload for cohort A due to a serialization bug in auth-service.

alex: mitigation: pause rollout for role-mapping-v2, and hotfix UI gating to rely on server-side permission blob. Can QA reproduce on staging if we flip flag? jia: yes.

sam: quick hotfix suggestion in frontend (pseudo):
```
if (!serverPermissions.includes('keys.rotate')) {
  hideRotateButton();
}
```
Also add server-side middleware: if user.role === 'viewer' && !perm('keys.rotate') -> 403.

maria: rolling back role-mapping-v2 now. ETA 8m. I'll also add a ticket to patch auth-service serialization for KMS payloads: AUTH-879.

oliver: for audit logging we should include these fields: 'actor_id','effective_roles','feature_flags','kms_key_id' — currently kms_key_id empty for cohort A.

sec-bot: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/acl-visual-leak. Follow steps 1-6 and add postmortem if confirmed.

alex: assign owners
- maria: rollback + AUTH-879
- sam: frontend gating PR and middleware
- oliver: KMS audit payload fix
- jia: repro and verify rollback on prod

jia: will verify after rollback and post status here. Thanks all :lock:

maria: rollback complete at 10:20 UTC. Rolling check now.

jia: verified — rotate button hidden for viewer on prod after rollback. Audit payloads for previous hits exported to incident folder.

alex: follow-ups: add server-side render checks in 2FA sprint, add unit tests for audit serialization, and schedule canary for role-mapping changes with more telemetry.

sam: noted. I'll open FRONT-1293 for server-side guard and add unit test.

jia: closing thread when postmortem attached to INC-2026-0319-27

sec-bot: Postmortem link attached: https://internal.redwood/pm/INC-2026-0319-27/postmortem
